title: Community Seed Library Catalogue Refactoring
originalRequest: Develop database schema and backend models to support plant taxonomy data, germination rate tracking, and inventory status for the seed library.
latestMessage: Develop database schema and backend models to support plant taxonomy data, germination rate tracking, and inventory status for the seed library.

steps.title: Database Migration for Taxonomy and Viability Tracking
steps.instruction: Create a PostgreSQL schema migration to add 'genus', 'species', and 'cultivar' fields to the catalogued seeds table, and establish a 'germination_tests' tracking table linked via foreign key.
steps.acceptance: Migration executes without error on the target database, creating the fields and the new table with appropriate constraints, foreign keys, and indices on taxonomy fields.
steps.result: Created the SQL migration script defining the new columns on the 'seeds' table and the schema for the 'germination_tests' table. Currently running localized integration tests on the migration script to verify constraints and rollback execution before deploying to the staging database environment.
